# MP3 to MP4 Studio

> Free browser-based MP3 to MP4 converter with cover art video generation and optional YouTube upload.

MP3 to MP4 Studio helps users convert MP3 audio and cover images into optimized MP4 videos. The app supports direct download, YouTube upload through OAuth, realtime progress feedback, and Thai/English UI.

## Key Pages

- [MP3 to MP4 Studio](https://convert.kindeeyudee.com/): Convert MP3 files to MP4 videos, download the result, or upload to YouTube.
- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/TheDevilzz/MP3-to-MP4-Converter): Source code, deployment notes, and project documentation.

## Primary Topics

- MP3 to MP4 conversion
- Audio to video conversion
- Cover art video generation
- Browser-based FFmpeg conversion
- YouTube video upload
